Cell.Data: Futuristic James Bond / Men in Black / Sci-Fi / Improbable Gadgets.
Passed from generation to generation. Old and ancient stuff. Dusty and previously owned by living legends and other very old people.
The inverse of "Tractor pull", which already exists in Magicka.
melee weapon. In English, the name rhymes and sounds like a college class (Chemistry 201, for example).
矮人出品，必属精品， 电动开关设计好温馨 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;打了就跑
hit the target with a garbage collector claw, inflict some damage and teleports player at the same time
This marriage of modern dwarven magicks and an electronically controlled claw allows you to be both mildly annoying and safe. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Hit and Run
melee. Diplomacy+domination. Makes friends by healing (a diplomatic thing to do), but dominates by charming.
自然而然地...你们就是“伙伴”了 #DMG;治疗目标 #SP;魅惑
在对手的脑门上制造亿万只小虫 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;小虫能引起恐慌
damages target and inflicts "fear". "apply directly to the forehead" is a reference to the HeadOn internet meme.
Applies nano-magick lice directly to your enemy's forehead. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Lice-Induced Panic
慵懒纵火者的得力助手 #DMG;低火系伤害 #SP;燃烧
fires a glob of fire that ignites things
The lazy arsonist's best friend. #DMG;Low Fire #SP;Burn
为了能在夏季举办冬运会而设计， 不过很快就被应用于防爆和外科手术 #DMG;低寒冷伤害 #SP;冰冻
fires a ball of ice that chills targets in an area on impact
Designed for the annual summertime winter games, but was quickly adopted by both law enforcement and Surgeons Without Sanity. #DMG;Low Cold #SP;Freeze
它的前一个拥有者绝不是森林巨魔， 绝不... #DMG;无 #SP;推搡
a big rifle that pushes things away
Its former owner was definitely not a Forest Troll, anyway. #DMG;None #SP;Push
用于制造大范围毁灭效果的装置 #DMG;威力无穷的火箭 #SP;无

launches a ball/rocket that inflicts healing in an area on impact. The rocket itself can, theoretically, inflict direct physical damage to its target; but mostly it just heals the enemy. The joke is that the description does not mention that it's useless for damaging your enemy (except to say it's malfunctioning). Instead the description says what it's *supposed* to do, and says that the rockets are *powerful*, without mentioning what that power is.
Designed to inflict devastating damage across a large area. #DMG;Extremely Powerful Rockets #SP;None
staff, but something like a construction worker's utility belt.
适合任何人使用,如抽脂医师, 专业酒驾人士等... #PA;增强物理和闪电抵抗 #AA;油腻

Fitted with pouches and compartments for all kinds of things technical. Also serves as a grease dispenser and a somewhat impractical screwdriver. #PA;Increases Physical and Lightning Resistances #AA;Grease
长期暴露在放射源下 可能会死得很滑稽哦. #PA;加强闪电法术伤害 #AA;消除热源
Purge heat simply launches a fire bolt, the idea being that the rod is releasing its energy, like in a nuclear reactor. "severe death" is meant to be an amusingly redundant hyperbole.
Prolonged exposure to active components may cause severe death. #PA;Increased Lightning Spell Damage #AA;Purge Heat
无法反抗，无法对抗， 只有一种可能… #PA;加强奥术法术伤害 #AA;拉扯

casts "inverse push" or tractor beam. In experimental physics, a fusion engine has never been achieved, and may not be feasible. Hence probably impossible, or to make it amusing "probably not probable". "Improbability" is a slight hint to Hitchhiker's guide's "improbability drive".
不仅仅可以挂在墙上…… 还能拿在手里,化在舌尖 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;慢速,击退
slow melee thrust weapon that inflicts heavy damage and knockback
Having been previously affixed to a wall it is now majestically affixed to your hand. (Originally affixed to a moose.) #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Slow, Knockback
睹物思人,犹记那年祖母的微笑… #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;中毒
punching or slashing weapon that inflicts low physical damage and poison
A set of teeth with huge, hollow fangs stained with blood. It fondly calls granny's smile to mind. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Poison
某场战争的遗留物,没人用过 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;无
simple and fast thrust weapon that increases wielder's movement speed slightly
A relic from a war in which it was never used. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;None
已经锈透的老爷枪,威力貌似不错 #DMG;高物理伤害 #SP;非常慢
simple, very slow but very powerful rifle
Its clockwork ramrod contraption rusted through long ago. Complete with oaken rolliche compartments. #DMG;High Physical #SP;Very Slow
唔,俗话说千万别浪费“生命”… #DMG;低奥术伤害 #SP;中毒,溅射
throws body parts that on impact inflict arcane damage and fear. It "throws" the opposite of Life -- arcane spells and dead parts.
Well, they say never to throw your LIFE away, so... #DMG;Low Arcane #SP;Poison Splash
我曾经和你一样是个冒险者... #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;穿甲弹
simple fast-firing rifle (a glock with attached stock and flashlight). Magazine - the kind that holds bullets.
Remarkably well taken care of despite evident age and use. Comes with a small knitted pouch with extra mags and warm socks. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Armor Piercing
到底是反抗还是对抗啊 尼玛我分不清了！ #PA;增强生命法术,消耗生命 #AA;无
greatly increases player health and Life spells but constantly drains the player's health
Invokes images of both good and bad times past. #PA;Boosts Life spells and Health but Constantly Drains health #AA;None
直到我的膝盖中了一箭... #PA;扭曲时间,减少所有抗性 #AA;无
doubles the player's movement speed and vulnerabilities
The weight of it halves the speed of your stride but its power makes the rest of the world only a fourth as fast as normal. #PA;Warps Time but Decreases All Resistances #AA;None
代表太阳逮捕你，我就是王法！ #PA;无 #AA;捕获陷阱
either fires a glob that on impact erects a shield bubble OR erects a shield bubble around the player and then teleports the player away. Sentence = legal sentence/punishment
Impose your very own law with portable dungeons! #PA;None #AA;Entrapment
老人家出门再也不怕下雨和卖拐了 #PA;获得水系免疫,大地抵抗 但是会削弱水系法术 #AA;无
It's too old to bother unfolding, but due to its sheer stubbornness it works perfectly well nevertheless. #PA;Water Immunity and Earth Resistance, but Weaker Water spells #AA;None

还记得那些年被抽打的愉悦吗? #PA;轻微增强所有法术 #AA;净化(都安静!坐直了!)
A teacher's stick with a suitable Nullify-spell ("Quiet! Stop it!")
Adorned with countless dents in the shape of small fingers. #PA;Slight Boost to All Spells #AA;Nullify (Be quiet! Sit still!)
heavy metal - as in the style of music
"节操？节操是神马,有化肥好吃吗?" - 或北漂或南下的乡村巫师 - 其实你想说的是"节奏"吧？
Reference to AC-DC's song "Highway to Hell" (the line is "Don't need reason, don't need rhyme"). Going south = going to hell.
"Rhymes? Hah! I don't need no rhymes." - An angry musician migrating South
A staff with a mic attached in one end. "The last stand" is a common English idiom (taking a final stand, etc.).
法杖的一头粘着一枚巨大的麦克风 "农业重金属,乡村杀马特" #PA;增强闪电法术 #AA;魅惑
一切为了粗暴艺术 "农业重金属,乡村杀马特" #DMG;高物理,闪电伤害 #SP;慢速
trashing, as in violently slamming (and usually breaking) the guitar into the ground.
Designed with both trashing and fighting in mind. #DMG;High Physical and Lightning #SP;Slow
砰砰砰！啪啪啪！ - 曾经手持大锤,性格孤僻
Reference to M.C. Hammer's rap song "Can't Touch This". The word "hammered" (which also means "highly intoxicated") reinforces the joke. "once upon a time" is refering to the line "hammer time".
Nothing can come in contact with me! - A hammered wizard, once upon a time
此鼓只应天上有,人间能得几回闻 #PA;大地抵抗 #AA;范围击退
A very thick hollow staff with a stretched skin covering one end. #PA;Earth Resistance #AA;Area Knockback
有了它,啥都可以当鼓敲！ #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;打昏
With this, everything's a drum! #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Stun
Reference to "Epic Sax Guy", an internet meme
这儿真是个好地方…不过我想回家！ - “哦,回诶家,回诶诶家……” - 说着说着就唱了起来
Reference to "What a Wonderful World" by Louie Armstrong. "strong arms" = armstrong.
This is quite a great place. - A pondering wizard with strong arms
据说每件萨克斯管里 都住着一只口水小精灵哦！ #PA;加强水系,蒸汽法术 #AA;龙卷风
absorbant because saxophones generate and collect a lot of spittle. (ugh, yes -- gross)
Inside its neck resides a powerful and absorbent staff. #PA;Boosts Water and Steam Spells #AA;Tornado
哼哼哈嘿！快使用唱片机！ #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;击退,流血效果
Puns on Armstrong's songs "Sometimes I Feel Like a Motherless Child" ("faceless man" suits the wizards in Magicka since you never see their faces) and "Moon River" ("Spittle" because saxophone)
It features such favorites as "Sometimes I Feel Like A Faceless Man" and "Spittle River". #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Knockback, Bleed

Comes with matching fleece blanket. #PA;Boosts Lightning spells #AA;Revive
长得像个接力棒 #DMG;轻微闪电,物理伤害 #SP;击晕敌人

Flamos is a name and should not be changed

After a heated argument with his former employer, inevitably leaving him fired and with the wizard law enforcement hot on his trail, Flamos' found himself with but two infernal options: To fight flame with flame or burn out!

"Anyone can become hot stuff in but one simple step! Just come a bit closer!" - Flamboyant wizard draped in searing robes -#ITEM_flamos_weapon01; -#ITEM_flamos_staff01; -Healed by Fire -Resistant to Healing -Vulnerable to Ice, Water and Steam
太闪耀了,无处可藏 #PA;加强热系(火,蒸汽)法术 #AA;无

fire poker. Joke on "hot rod", a word for a fancy racing car.

In a chilling moment Coldarr, a once highly respected cryomancer, accidentally set loose a deadly spell towards his beloved. Blaming him for his recklessness, his wizard friends gave him the cold shoulder, slowly turning his heart to ice.

"I will freeze you. What, you expected a pun?" - A mysterious wizard too cool for puns -#ITEM_coldarr_weapon01; -#ITEM_coldarr_staff01; -Healed by Cold and Ice -Resistant to Healing -Immune to Chilled -Vulnerable to Fire and Steam
忍住想要舔它的欲望！ #PA;加强冷系(雪,冰冻)法术 #AA;无

The ultimate answer to when the other wizards won't stop picking on you -- pick back! #DMG;Light Cold and Physical damage #SP;Chills the target
强烈推荐联机玩的一张地图
The challenge map is a chamber in an evil villain's hideout where he lowers segments of the floor into lava while throwing monsters at the player.
After sticking your nose in an evil goblin supervillain's business, he responds by sticking your nose in LAVA!
异国情调十足的狂战之地
A large chamber with reflective crystals on the walls as well as reflective crystals being raised and lowered into the floor.
Exotic beasts! Unmeltable sub-terranean icicle pistons! Hissing doors! A really high ceiling! Everything an evil supervillain could ever want!
还记得你在边缘之境忙活的 那些事儿吗？这里也需要你！
A large floating cluster of islands (3) with bridges inbetween. Waves of daemonic and nightmarish creatures from edges and magical symbols from the center of all islands.
This world was once torn asunder by an evil supervillain experimenting with caffeine-infused vortices. All that remains is a handful of solid landmasses -- and relentless hordes of daemons.
